messages:
victor-cs: Hey team — customer signed up this morning but never received free trial credits. They completed email + phone verification and added a card, UI shows 0 credits. Account id acct_8d9f2b. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.s3/obf/screen1.png. Any quick checks?

olivia: Thanks — can you DM me the full account id and the payment method id? Also confirm if 3DS flow showed any errors to the user. Could be payment gating.

victor-cs: DM sent with acct_8d9f2b and pm_gh7. User saw the bank 3DS challenge but said it errored out. Region: DE, email verified.

support-bot: [automated-account-check] 
status: trial_eligibility=blocked; gate=payment_review_3ds_pending; last_payment_event=3ds_challenge_failed; created_at=2026-03-04T12:34:56Z

nate-billing: Looks like the 3DS challenge failed on our side (requires_action/failed). @carla-ops can you pull the payment webhook for pm_gh7 and confirm the 3DS result? If it's failed we can do a manual provisional grant while payments investigates.

carla-ops: pulling logs now. webhook shows payment_intent.created -> payment_intent.requires_action -> payment_intent.last_payment_error: {"type":"issuer_declined","code":"authentication_failed"}. 3DS challenge failed/declined by issuer. We'll escalate to payments, but I can do a manual grant for support to unblock the user.

olivia: Granting provisional trial credits (50) for acct_8d9f2b. Running internal command: 
```
/give_trial --acct acct_8d9f2b --credits 50 --reason "manual_grant_3ds_failed_support" --actor olivia
```

system: grant succeeded — new_balance=50 credits; granted_by=olivia; grant_id=grant_20260304_001

victor-cs: Confirmed with user — credits now show and they can call the API. They got a couple tokens through.

nate-billing: Adding note to payments ticket: manual grant due to issuer 3DS decline; request payments follow-up with acquiring bank and merchant settings.

victor-cs: Closing on this thread, user happy. :tada:
